capabilities: Build a wallpaper library from local folders and image providers
Apply blur, brightness, saturation, and hue adjustments
Rotate wallpapers on intervals and within time windows
Switch or save backgrounds from the status bar and command palette
Store provider credentials in Obsidian SecretStorage
disambiguation: Not a theme generator; it manages background wallpapers and tinting while leaving the active theme's text and controls unchanged.
extras: Provider credentials are stored through Obsidian SecretStorage; the plugin has no telemetry. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later.
problem: Obsidian themes do not provide a built-in way to collect, rotate, and adjust background wallpapers from multiple image sources.
